subject.title: [Bug]: The project won't start on Windows and WSL.

question: Should maintainers require a current-main Windows/WSL second-build repro before choosing between a tsdown dependency update/pin, wrapper repair, or rollback to a different build path?
rationale: The report is credible and affects a supported setup/build path, but the requested tsdown-to-tsc rollback is a broad build-system choice that automation should not make from screenshot evidence alone.

options.title: Require focused repro first
options.body: Run or request current-main Windows and WSL first-build/second-build terminal logs, then choose the smallest fix based on the isolated failure.

options.title: Treat as beta-blocking now
options.body: Promote this to an immediate beta-blocking build-tool investigation and let maintainers pick the rollback or dependency strategy before full repro proof lands.

options.title: Defer until reporter logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for the reporter or a maintainer to provide full current-main logs before assigning fix direction.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro first
recommendation.body: Run or request current-main Windows and WSL first-build/second-build terminal logs, then choose the smallest fix based on the isolated failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a build-system/product-direction choice, and current-main blame plus the reporter discussion both point to steipete for that call.
